$comment: Template registry for the Workflow Installer (spec 03 §2, §6).
`version` is the template semver stamped into every rendered file's header.
Bumping it is what makes a bulk resync (spec 03 §6) open update PRs across
every repo with that capability enabled. Resync compares rendered content
against what is actually in the repo rather than trusting this string, in
case someone hand-edited the file -- but the version is what tells an
operator, and a PR reviewer, that something changed and why.
